messages:
Mei: Quick PM follow-up -- we need a tight remediation sprint to close gaps from the eviction incident. Short list below, owners, and realistic timelines.
Arjun: Share the list please. prioritize anything that would have prevented the outage.
Mei: Items: 1) curated prompt/eval set for eviction+resume failures (20-30 cases); 2) regression that reproduces KV-eviction with long context; 3) burst load scenario (small-batch high-concurrency) for perf-ci; 4) 20-min chaos drill simulating intermittent shard restart; 5) integration test for KV cache warm-start after failover; 6) rollout gating rule for critical prompts.
Zoe: I'll take (1) prompt/eval set. plan: use recorded traces + synthetic variants, annotate pass/fail, add small scoring harness. ETA 2024-10-02.
Ben: I'll own (3) burst load scenario and add tail-latency + queue-length metrics to correlate with eval alerts. ETA 2024-09-25.
Arjun: I'll own (2) eviction regression and (5) cache warm-start integration test (lead) since they tie into runtime. Est 6 work days total, target 2024-10-05.
Mei: For (4) chaos drill, need Eng-SRE coordination for a safe staging window. Ben/Zoe loop SRE and keep blast radius small. Target 2024-10-10.
Zoe: Noted. small note: keep unit-level checks lightweight; full-regression runs nightly to avoid CI blowup.
infra-bot: Maintenance window available staging: 2024-10-09 02:00-04:00 UTC. React :thumbsup: to accept.
Mei: Proposal for (6) gating: if any critical prompt in the eval set drops >5% absolute accuracy/score, block rollout and auto-create a remediation ticket with owner=@oncall. Thoughts?
Arjun: Strong +1. We can wire eval alerts into the rollout pipeline and auto-open a ticket. I'll draft a short RFC and a small webhook.
Ben: For burst load, I'll add a template config to perf repo and a short runbook for running locally.
Zoe: I'll author the prompt-set PR today and include anonymized trace examples. reviewers: Mei, Ben.
Mei: Action items recap: A1 prompt set (Zoe) due 2024-10-02; A2 eviction regression + cache test (Arjun) due 2024-10-05; A3 burst load template (Ben) due 2024-09-25; A4 chaos drill + runbook (Ben/Zoe) due 2024-10-10; A5 gating RFC + webhook (Arjun) due 2024-09-22.
Mei: Add these to the postmortem board and tag "remediation" and "evals". I'll run a quick sync next week to check progress.
Zoe: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/evals/pull/501 (draft prompt-set).
Ben: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/perf/pull/99 (burst config template).
Arjun: RFC drafted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/eval-gating (WIP).
Mei: Thanks team. Keep the tests focused and small; escalate to Eng-Platform if infra blocks delay the work.
sched-bot: Reminder: remediation sprint sync 2024-09-20 16:00 UTC  attendees: Mei, Arjun, Zoe, Ben.
